codeReview.summary: Fix successfully addresses the original blocking issues. (1) StoreError now stores stderr instead of discarding it: removed `_ = stderr` and added `Stderr: stderr` in event struct. (2) Added Stderr field to JobEvent struct so it can be persisted. (3) Tests now properly verify markFailedWithStderr behavior (calls the method, asserts expectations). All tests pass. Note: markFailedWithStderr is not wired to CLI execution results at runtime (no production caller), but the infrastructure and tests are in place.
